status_policy.passed_limited: All registered pytest nodes executed successfully; claims remain limited to the named structural component.
status_policy.failed: At least one registered executable assertion failed or the runner itself could not execute it.
status_policy.blocked: The required first-class capability is absent; no proxy test is run and no pass is claimed.

scenarios.title: Capability plus real artifact witness
scenarios.fault_injection: Remove the hash-bound artifact while retaining the declared capability.
scenarios.blocked_reason: No candidate-level registry jointly validates an actual retrieval capability and a resolvable hash-bound artifact before claim/attempt. Capability leases and source refs are not an artifact witness.
scenarios.claim_limit: No T evidence is claimed until the artifact-witness contract exists.

scenarios.title: Shadow rehearsal is write-isolated
scenarios.fault_injection: Select a shadow candidate whose simulated forecast is positive and verify all execution/learning counters remain zero.
scenarios.claim_limit: Proves the current shadow coordinator write surface and counters only; it does not prove every future prediction store is isolated.

scenarios.title: Cross-scope private material is rejected
scenarios.fault_injection: Substitute a source from user B into user A's proposal despite matching topic keywords.
scenarios.claim_limit: Proves DTO/build scope isolation at the named entrypoint, not every future retrieval query.

scenarios.title: Duplicate delivery ACK is exactly once
scenarios.component: live settlement and duplicate ACK handling
scenarios.fault_injection: Replay the identical successful terminal acknowledgement three times.
scenarios.claim_limit: Proves internal live-commit settlement idempotency, not external platform exactly-once delivery.

scenarios.title: Partial observation window is censored
scenarios.fault_injection: End a six-hour observation after two hours with no reply.
scenarios.claim_limit: Proves the pure label settlement contract; no training repository integration is inferred.

scenarios.title: Permission revoke prevents stale dispatch
scenarios.fault_injection: Revoke permission after high readiness, then re-allow and check no old decision is dispatched.
scenarios.blocked_reason: No single Langchao lifecycle API currently connects readiness, permission_version, claim/outbox creation, revocation, re-enable, and stale-decision invalidation. Legacy pre-send boundary tests cannot prove the no-backlog contract.
scenarios.claim_limit: No T evidence is claimed for the requested full lifecycle.

scenarios.title: Failed and unknown send are not user rejection
scenarios.fault_injection: Inject a terminal send failure and a missing/unknown acknowledgement.
scenarios.claim_limit: Failure is terminally covered; unknown is evidenced only as a durable pending commit with no duplicate commit, not as a complete reconciliation policy.

scenarios.title: Four no-send reasons share one taxonomy
scenarios.fault_injection: Hold other inputs fixed while selecting no-candidate, competition defer, permission denial, or delivery failure.
scenarios.blocked_reason: The four reasons are emitted by different layers and representations; no first-class unified audit taxonomy/result object exists. Running four unrelated tests would be proxy evidence and is intentionally refused.
scenarios.claim_limit: No unified-taxonomy T evidence is claimed.

scenarios.title: Permission projection follows event time
scenarios.fault_injection: Deliver allow and deny histories in opposite order, including reverse ingestion order.
scenarios.blocked_reason: Existing revoke/reactivate primitives do not expose a single same-scope allow/deny event projection with occurred_at ordering bound to Langchao permission_version. Upsert-order tests cannot substitute for this contract.
scenarios.claim_limit: No T evidence is claimed for temporal successor semantics.

scenarios.title: Deletion tombstone invalidates dependencies
scenarios.fault_injection: Tombstone the sole source supporting an active projection and replay a proposal created before deletion.
scenarios.claim_limit: Proves the isolated repository contract with a deterministic connection double; real PostgreSQL evidence remains separate.
